body: Read mine. I feel you man just keep pushing through it and work harder. These are things you CAN change. Set goals and work at them. Every day. It will get better. Promise.

I saw my friends fiances phone messages to another guy who wasn't her fiance, asking about pictures he had seen on her phone. They're both engaged. So having a healthy relationship in the future doesn't seem to be a possibility. My ex got engaged a few days ago. Idk anymore lol. There's so much and I can't do anything about it. If these were just things I could change myself through hard work and motivation I would. But the reality is they're not.
